messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: ERROR spike on /console/configs and API discrepancy detected for account acme-corp. Impact: console shows feature_x = ON, API returns feature_x = OFF. Suggested urgency: P1. Paging maria (oncall)

maria (oncall): acked. joining bridge. severity P1 — starting triage. @kayla can you confirm customer-visible impact?

kayla (support): Customer reported UI shows toggles on but workflows failing. They see 502s when saving settings. No large increase in support tickets yet but single paying customer affected.

sam (eng-sre): quick checks: querying control-plane config API vs console state.

sam (eng-sre): curl outputs:
```
# control plane API (configs)
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/configs/acme-corp | jq .feature_x
false

# console (frontend cached copy)
# frontend GET /console/configs returns JSON with feature_x: true
```

sam (eng-sre): logs show config_publish events at 2026-05-01T12:07:23Z then a publish failure retry loop around 12:08-12:12.

sam (eng-sre): snippets from config-publisher logs:
```
[2026-05-01T12:07:23Z] INFO publish start for acme-corp v3
[2026-05-01T12:07:24Z] ERROR push to controlplane: 503 Service Unavailable (upstream timeout)
[2026-05-01T12:07:24Z] WARN retrying publish (1/5)
[2026-05-01T12:08:01Z] INFO publish succeeded for acme-corp v3 (but partial acks)
```

sam (eng-sre): interestingly console cache has TTL 10m and may have served stale true value while control plane ended up with OFF because downstream dataplane rejected partial publish.

raj (runtime): on dataplane side I see spike in 502/504 from placement-service at 12:07-12:09 — could be transient overload causing partial ack to control plane. grabbing runtime logs for placement nodes. trace ids: trace-7e9a, trace-7ea0.

raj (runtime): runtime excerpt:
```
[placement-3] 12:07:24 WARN allocation timeout for acme-corp v3, error=deadline_exceeded
[placement-3] 12:07:25 ERROR push to kv-cache: rpc error: code = Unavailable
```

sam (eng-sre): hypothesis A: config-publisher attempted to push v3; placement/dataplane overloaded -> partial success -> control-plane state marked OFF while console cache still shows ON.

sam (eng-sre): hypothesis B: race between rollout of rollouts/flags service and a config-schema change caused publisher to fallback to previous value for safety. need to confirm publisher logic.

maria (oncall): immediate mitigation options?

raj (runtime): mitigation: force-rollback to last known-good v2 on both control-plane and console cache, or re-run publish after clearing placement backlog. Quickest low-risk is to invalidate console cache for acme-corp and re-run publish with smaller batches.

sam (eng-sre): I can invalidate console cache from admin: POST /internal/cache/invalidate {org: acme-corp} — doing that now.

sam (eng-sre): cache invalidation triggered. Observed console now queries control-plane again.

sam (eng-sre): after invalidation, console shows feature_x = false (matches API). UI save requests still intermittently 502 when hitting placement-service.

kayla (support): letting customer know we're investigating and pushing rollback if needed. Suggested message: "we're aware of config mismatch and working on mitigation; no user data lost. We'll provide an update in 30m."

taylor (console): adding this to console runbook: note that admin cache invalidation was used and timestamped. Also logging frontend request IDs for correlation.

maria (oncall): handoff plan: sam continue with control-plane and cache work; raj take runtime placement backlog + rerun publish once placement clears; taylor track frontend errors; kayla own customer comms. If we can't get stable publish in 30m escalate to SRE lead.

sam (eng-sre): tracking actions in-thread:
- ACTION-1: sam invalidate console cache (done)
- ACTION-2: raj drain placement-3 and restart placement workers (in progress)
- ACTION-3: sam re-run publisher with batch-size=50 after placement clear
- ACTION-4: taylor collect frontend reqIDs and broken save payload (ongoing)
- ACTION-5: kayla send 30m status to acme-corp (pending)

raj (runtime): placement workers restart initiated. ETA 8min. I'll stream logs to the bridge.

sam (eng-sre): re-run publish attempt queued, will wait for raj confirmation.

incident-bot: Bridge created https://zoom.redwood.example/j/INC-2065400000. Pager suppressed for 10m (manual).

maria (oncall): mid-triage note: Impact: single customer ACME, settings visible mismatch and save failures. Risk: if publish runs again while placement degraded we may get partial apply and flip past state. Plan prefers ensuring placement health then publish.

raj (runtime): placement stabilized at 12:18:01Z, errors dropped below 1/min. ready for re-run.

sam (eng-sre): re-running publisher with batch-size=50 and strict consistency flag (--require-ack=true). curl to trigger:
```
POST /internal/publisher/publish?org=acme-corp&batch=50&require_ack=true
```

sam (eng-sre): publish logs:
[2026-05-01T12:19:05Z] INFO publish start for acme-corp v3
[2026-05-01T12:19:08Z] INFO push to controlplane: OK
[2026-05-01T12:19:09Z] INFO push to placement: OK
[2026-05-01T12:19:10Z] INFO all acks received

sam (eng-sre): after publish, console and API both show feature_x = true. Performing quick validation on save flow.

taylor (console): ran frontend end-to-end with acme test org — save succeeded, no 502. frontend telemetry shows reduced error rate.

kayla (support): updated customer: "we've applied a fix; settings should be consistent now. Please confirm and report if you still see errors. Apologies for the disruption."

maria (oncall): wrapping: root cause summary draft: partial failure of config-publisher due to transient placement-service overload at 12:07-12:09 -> partial ack and cache mismatch between console and control-plane -> UI showed old value while API reflected safer fallback. Mitigation: cache invalidation + placement restart + re-run publisher with require-ack.

maria (oncall): post-incident follow-ups:
- RCA doc (assign to sam)
- Add health-check gating before publisher marks success (assign raj)
- Improve publisher telemetry for partial-ack detection (assign sam)
- Update runbook: always verify placement health before large publishes (assign taylor)

sam (eng-sre): I'll draft RCA and link logs + traces (trace-7e9a, trace-7ea0).

raj (runtime): I'll add gating and an alert if placement error rate > 0.5% during publish windows.

maria (oncall): thanks team. closing bridge in 10. keep thread for RCA notes.

kayla (support): customer confirmed fixes on their side. closing loop. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident resolved. Duration ~ 0:25:00. Severity: P1 -> downgraded to P2 after mitigation.
